overview: In British Columbia, therapy searches cluster around the Lower Mainland and around online care. Practices that name their registration, their approach and the communities they genuinely serve are easier for both Google and AI assistants to describe accurately.
Our Vancouver work is delivered remotely from Ontario, with content and profile work scoped to how BC clients actually search.

city_blurbs.vancouver: Dense competition in Kitsilano and Mount Pleasant, with heavy demand for trauma and couples specialisms.
